caption: The drawing depicts a single green pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher has a bulbous, textured body featuring a diamond pattern and is rendered in shades of green with darker green accents for shading and depth. It has a wide spout, a curved handle adorned with a decorative flourish at its base, and a narrow pedestal foot. The pitcher appears glossy with highlights suggesting a reflective surface. In the bottom right area of the paper, the name "JANET RIZA" is written in light, uppercase letters. There are no additional objects, and the composition is centered with the pitcher occupying the main area of the image.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
